lead: Newt Gingrich is an American politician, born on 17 June 1943 in Harrisburg.
As of 2026, he is 83 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has 16 credited works on public record and has held the office of United States representative and Speaker of the United States House of Representatives.

sections.heading: Newt Gingrich — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Newt Gingrich was born on 17 June 1943 in Harrisburg, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Newton Leroy Gingrich at birth and is publicly known as Newt Gingrich.
He is a sibling of Candace Gingrich.
He received his education at Emory University, Tulane University, Baker High School and Tulane University.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Newt Gingrich — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, novelist, writer, teacher and historian as his occupations, including work with The Washington Times, University of West Georgia and American Solutions for Winning the Future.

He has held the following offices: United States representative (1979–1999), Speaker of the United States House of Representatives (1995–1999), United States representative (1997–1999), United States representative (1995–1997), United States representative (1993–1995) and United States representative (1991–1993). He is affiliated with Republican Party.
